Commentary.Commentary: 'Ireland will win in 7 overs,' chides my colleague. Can Nigeria give some fight with the ball? At least take a wicket or two? Drag the game into the 10th over or beyond? The run chase is not far away...

Craig Young says that it feels really good to take a 4-fer, that too, in front of the cameras. Says that a lot of hard work has gone into the results. On the advice given by the bowling coach, Young says that he was told not to go too hard searching for the swing and just try and bowl it in the right areas. Stresses that he is ready to do whatever the team asks of him.

Perfect outing for Ireland. They utilized the grass on the deck, or whatever was available and landed the ball in the right areas. Kept the ball pretty straight, which is evident from the fact that as many as 5 batsmen were dismissed bowled. Every bowler enjoyed his outing but Craig Young enjoyed the most, with a 4-fer. Here he is, giving an interview.

Right. Not quite what Nigeria would have wanted, after electing to bat. They played out all the 20 overs but did not even manage 100. Just 66, with 2 batsmen reaching double figures and the highest score being 19. The batsmen had no clue about swing or pace and only seemed comfortable when the spinners were on.

Short and wide outside off, Sesan leaps and looks to punch it over the top. Just about manages to clear the infield. The batsmen think about the second but take only the single. 66/9 IS ALL WHAT NIGERIA HAVE MANAGED.
Landed outside off, Adedeji backs away to slash but misses.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Full and down the leg side, Akachukwu looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.

Outside off, Akachukwu punches it through point. Comes back for the second and almost runs straight into the throw! Wilson was trying to warn him to be away but the advice was paid no heed. Luckily for him, the throw just misses his head.

IN THE AIR... JUST SHORT! Almost a 5-fer for Young. Full and outside off, Sesan looks to push but the ball flies off the surface, catches the batsman by surprises, hits the top of the bat and goes towards short extra cover. George Dockrell comes charging in but the ball lands just in front! End of a sensational bowling inning for Young - 4-0-13-4.
A bouncer outside off, Adedeji ducks.
Who is left? Chima Akachukwu is the number 11 batsman.

OUT! CAUGHT! Wicket number 4 for Young and second wicket in the space of 3 balls! A length ball outside off, Adewoye looks to heave it to the off side but gets a top edge. It has gone nowhere as George Dockrell at short extra cover comes running in and takes it around his face. Can Young get a 5-fer?
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Vincent Adewoye comes in at number 10, replacing Sylvester Okpe.

OUT! BOWLED! The off stump takes a beating. That is the fifth batsman getting bowled today! Full and around off, Okpe looks to defend but the ball straightens a touch, beats the outside edge and sends the off stump flying. Third wicket for Young.
Full and outside off, Adedeji looks to drive but the ball takes the outside edge. Third man is very fine, so it will just be a single.
Full and outside off, SO looks to cut but misses again.
Landed outside off, Sylvester looks to run it down to third man but misses.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.

Landed outside off, Okpe looks to run it down to third man but gets a thick outside edge. The ball lands in front of the keeper who cannot quite collect it cleanly. It deflects off his body to the leg side and the batsmen scamper through for a quick single.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Sylvester Okpe comes in at number 9, replacing Oyede.

OUT! BOWLED! Don't think one can bowl a better yorker than that. Perfectly angled, targetting the leg stump, Oyede is beaten by the swing, cannot get his bat down in time, it is too quick for him. The leg stump takes a cartwheel.
Mark Adair is back on. 2-1-4-1 so far.
Short and outside off, Adedeji hops and looks to play the upper cut but is beaten due to the extra bounce.
Around off, worked towards short mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, on a length, Oyede looks to defend but is beaten on the outside edge.
Full and outside off, solidly defended towards cover.
Leke Oyede walks in at number 8, replacing Okpe.

OUT! BOWLED! Outfoxed by the lack of pace. A length ball, in line of the stumps, Okpe backs away again, attempting a similar shot to the previous one, aiming to go over the bowler but goes a touch too early. Misses as the ball comes very slowly, goes past the bat and hits the middle stump. End of a decent looking partnership, worth 24.

Landed outside off, Okpe backs away and smacks it over the bowler. Then, just stands over there and admires his shot. Then, realizes that the ball will not go to the boundary and starts running. Two runs taken.
Craig Young returns. 2-0-9-1 so far.
A short ball, down the leg side, Okpe looks to pull but misses and is hit on the pads. Wilson tries to collect but fumbles and takes it on the bounce. 4-0-16-1 for Dockrell.
Landed outside off, pushed towards point.
Outside off, Isaac looks to punch but gets a bottom edge which just misses the stumps and goes to short fine leg.

Short and outside off once more, Okpe gives himself room to the leg side and punches it through the covers. Stuart Thompson from long off gets across to his left and slides, stopping the ball. Two runs taken.
Short again, Adedeji swivels and pulls it past Paul Stirling at short fine leg for a single towards long leg.
Short and outside off, slapped wide of long off for a couple. Good piece of running.
Full and around off, well blocked out. Rankin is done - 4-1-10-0. Superb effort.

Short and wide outside off, Adedeji throws his bat at it, looking to cut, but gets a thick outside edge down to third man. Does not carry. A single taken. 50 UP FOR NIGERIA! It has been some achievement.
Landed around off, pushed towards point for a single.
Around off, pushed towards mid on.

TOP EDGE, FOUR! Not gone where he intended to. A short ball outside off, Okpe looks to pull but the ball bounces extra, takes the top edge and goes over the keeper to the third man fence, beating third man!
Landed outside off, pushed straight to point.
Nicely bowled, outside off, tossed up, defended from the crease.
A short ball, outside off, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
Around off, blocked from the crease.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, Adedeji gets down and pulls it through square leg for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
George Dockrell is back into the attack. 2-0-8-1 so far.
Landed outside off, watchfully left alone.
Full and around middle, worked through square leg, off the inside edge for a single.
Back of a length around off, Sesan stays back to defend.
Landed outside off, Adedeji slashes hard but misses.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Around off, on a length, pushed back down the track.
Boyd Rankin returns. 2-1-3-0 so far.

Short and wide outside off, Delany gets away with it. Okpe cuts it hard but Kevin O'Brien at short cover does well to get a hand to it. He parries it behind and the batsmen take a couple. 4-0-17-1 for Gareth Delany today.
Full and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Okpe misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Gareth Delany is bowling out. 3-0-15-1 so far.
FOUR! That is a terrific shot. Full and outside off, swinging in, Adedeji looks to flick, loses his balance but still flicks it over mid-wicket!
Outside off, pushed through point for a run.
Around off, solidly defended.
Isaac Okpe walks in at number 7, replacing Onwuzulike.

OUT! BOWLED! A length ball outside off, Onwuzulike looks to just play a heave but there is no feet movement. The ball stays a touch low, takes the inside edge and shatters the woodwork behind. Half the side down.

Landed outside off, Adedeji pushes it towards point and scampers across for a quick single. Harry Tector charges across to his right from backward point, gets to the ball, picks it up and has a shy at the bowler's end. Misses but the batsman was well in.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.

Full and outside off, Chimezie brings out a soft reverse sweep. Why soft? Because there is no power in it. There is no short third man and by the time backward point can get there, two runs are taken.
Around middle, tucked through square leg for a run.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.

On the helmet again! Full and around off, Onwuzulike looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the grille of the helmet. The batsman smiles, the umpire asks him whether he is fine and signals a thumbs to the physio, asking him to stay where he is.
Full and around middle, worked through square leg for a single.
Landed around middle, watchfully defended.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Around off, worked through square leg for a single.
Here comes the mandatory concussion check. Onwuzulike looks okay though. The physio is happy and off he goes. We are ready to resume.
ON THE HELMET! A short ball outside off, a sharp bouncer, Chimezie looks to pull but misses. The ball goes off his helmet towards point.
Landed on a length outside off, pushed towards backward point. The batsmen think about the single but Kevin O'Brien puts in a superb slide to his left. That makes the batsmen change their minds.
Full and outside off, watchfully pushed towards cover for a single.
And almost strikes straightaway. Full and wide outside off, Adedeji looks to play an expansive drive but misses.
Craig Young to bowl now.
Around off, worked through square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Close shave! Outside off, Adedeji looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Gary Wilson appeals for LBW but there was a big inside edge there.
Sesan Adedeji walks in at number 6, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Caught! A catching drill. Full and around middle, Onikoyi gets down to paddle but all he musters is a simple scoop to Paul Stirling at short fine leg. This is just going from bad to worse. Ireland are not even celebrating. Nigeria are 24/4!
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and straight again, pushed down to long on for a single.
Full and around middle, watchfully pushed towards short mid-wicket.
George Dockrell to bowl his left-arm spin.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. A maiden for Rankin, whose figures read 2-1-3-0.
A short ball outside off, Onwuzulike looks to pull but misses and is hit on the back.
A short ball, down the leg side, Onwuzulike looks to pull but misses. Strangely, no wide signalled.
DROPPED! Full and outside off, hammered straight back. Rankin sticks his left hand out but cannot hang on. The ball is parried it to cover.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and outside off, Onwuzulike looks to slog but misses.
Boyd Rankin to bowl again. 1-0-3-0 so far.

LBW shout, but turned down. Two noises perhaps? Tossed up around middle, AO looks to play the slog but misses and is hit on the pads. Not quite sure whether there was an inside edge but it seemed to be going down leg. 22/3 in the Powerplay for Nigeria.
Around middle and leg, cramping the batsman for room, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Too full again and is punished again! Outside off, comes with a touch of width as well, Ademola gets under it and lofts it over extra cover!
Corrects his length, does Delany, landing it short of full, the skipper punches it towards short extra cover.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full and outside off, too full perhaps, Onikoyi gets under it and lofts it over mid off!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover. A WICKET MAIDEN FOR ADAIR!
Outside off, Onikoyi looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which bounces, goes past the stumps and into the keeper's gloves.
Outside off, fuller in length, Onikoyi looks to punch but misses.
Ademola Onikoyi, the captain, comes on to bat at number 5, replacing Gim.
OUT! Caught behind! Nigeria are in a sorry state now. Landed outside off, Gim looks to drive this on the up but the ball moves away, takes the outside edge and the keeper does the rest.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Mark Adair comes back on. 1-0-4-0 so far.
A lovely inswinging yorker, around middle, dug out back to the bowler.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
Chimezie Onwuzulike comes on.

OUT! RUN OUT! Total mix-up. Around middle, Runsewe paddles it towards backward square leg. Now, fine leg is deep and the batsmen think that a second is on. But it isn't. George Dockrell comes charging in from fine leg and returns a sharp throw to the keeper who whips the bails off. Runsewe dives in but is late.
Full and around off, Runsewe gets down and paddles it fine for a couple.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Slowly bowled, but angling down the leg side, the batsman misses his flick and is hit on the pads. There is a mild appeal for LBW but it is turned down.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a couple.
Around off, defended to the off side.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, Runsewe looks to flick but misses.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Boyd Rankin comes on to bowl now.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Daniel Gim arrives at number 3, replacing Ajekun.
OUT! Chopped on! Landed outside off, Ajekun looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which knocks the off stump out of the ground! Early strike for Ireland.
On middle and leg, worked towards square leg.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
On middle and leg, flicked towards square leg for a single.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Gareth Delany to share the new ball with Adair.
EDGED, NO ONE THERE! Full and around off, Ajekun looks to drive but misses and gets a thick outside edge, which flies past first slip towards third man! Two runs taken.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and around off, Ajekun looks to flick but misses and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a couple. Nigeria are underway!
Outside off, driven towards mid off.
Full on middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
The players are out in the middle. Mark Adair to start off proceedings. Daniel Ajekun and Sulaimon Runsewe to open for Kenya. Ajekun to take strike. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Bazid Khan observes that the pitch is the same one as used for the Canada-Oman game. Feels that since this is a day match, the ball will not skid onto the bat. Feels that the track is good for batting, so change of pace is key.

Wilson says that he was looking to bowl anyway and now, aims to dismiss Nigeria to as low a total as possible. Is not too focussed on improving the net run rate and just believes to play good cricket. Has a look at the wicket and he too, like Onikoyi, believes that the track will not change much.

Nigerian captain says that the wicket plays almost the same, so he would like to bat and enjoy the conditions. In spite of being knocked out, he says that it is a big stage and are still enjoying competing here. Would want to end the tournament with a couple of wins.

Ireland (Playing XI) - Gary Wilson(C AND WK), Paul Stirling, Mark Adair, Andrew Balbirnie, Gareth Delany, George Dockrell, Kevin O'Brien, Boyd Rankin, Harry Tector, Stuart Thompson (IN FOR DAVID DELANY) and Craig Young.

Nigeria (Playing XI) - Daniel Ajekun, Sulaimon Runsewe, Chimezie Onwuzulike, Ademola Onikoyi(C AND WK), Sesan Adedeji, Isaac Okpe (IN FOR ABIODUN ABIOYE), Leke Oyede, Daniel Gim, Sylvester Okpe, Vincent Adewoye and Chima Akachukwu.
TOSS - NIGERIA HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO BAT FIRST.

Ireland's previous win against Jersey was a massive one and they will aim for a repeat today. Nigeria have not got anything going for them so far - but with their tournament done and with nothing to lose, they can aim to be party spoilers and get something for themselves in their final two games.

We are approaching the dying stages of the league stage with two days left for the teams to stake a claim for the playoffs. Nigeria, sadly, are out of reckoning but Ireland have plenty to play for. Hello and a warm welcome to match number 35 of the ICC WT20 Qualifiers, 2019, between Ireland and Nigeria in Abu Dhabi.
